name: singlet_dim_reduction_scalable_truncated_svd
title: Approximate PCA and truncated SVD
description: Computes the leading k principal components of a normalised, highly-variable-gene layer with implicit centring, using exact ARPACK-type or Lanczos solvers (CPU and GPU), randomized SVD, or a covariance eigendecomposition. The default auto uses ARPACK on CPU and Lanczos or covariance_eigh on GPU. Reads layers/log1p_norm and var/highly_variable; writes obsm/X_pca, varm/PCs and uns/pca. Do not use it to choose k (use singlet_dim_reduction_pc_number_selection), to remove batch effects, or to fit count-model latent factors.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Normalised layer under layers/ to decompose after implicit centring.

use_hvg.description: Restrict to var/highly_variable; the call fails if the mask is absent.

n_components.description: Number of leading singular triplets k to compute.

svd_solver.description: auto: arpack on CPU; lanczos or covariance_eigh on GPU by gene count; randomized only on request.

zero_center.description: Centre genes implicitly before the decomposition; false decomposes the uncentred matrix.

dtype.description: Working precision; float64 is the reference, float32 is opt-in.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

seed.description: Seed for randomized test matrices and Krylov start vectors.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory, device and resolved solver without running.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

options.description: Method-specific options; each object applies only to the solver of the same name.

n_oversamples.description: Extra Gaussian test vectors p; the block size is k + p.

n_iter.description: Power iterations q; more iterations sharpen slowly decaying spectra.

tol.description: Ritz residual tolerance, relative to the top singular value.

ncv.description: Krylov dimension; null uses the size-dependent rule.

tol.description: Convergence tolerance for the Krylov solver; 0 is the sklearn PCA default.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written: obsm/X_pca, varm/PCs, uns/pca. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: For completed runs: k, solver, device, dtype, variance_ratio_sum and relative_gap_at_k. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device and solver.
